sonora_ca.name: Sonora
sonora_ca.obs_note: Sonora has no NWS observing station. The readings come from the Green Spring fire-weather station, 12 miles away and about 700 ft lower.

alerts.headline: Red Flag Warning issued October 14 at 10:14AM PDT until October 16 at 10:00AM PDT by NWS Sacramento CA
alerts.description:
...RED FLAG WARNING IN EFFECT FROM MIDNIGHT TONIGHT TO 10 AM PDT
FRIDAY DUE TO WIND AND LOW RELATIVE HUMIDITY FOR PORTIONS OF CENTRAL
AND NORTHERN CALIFORNIA...

The National Weather Service in Sacramento CA has issued a Red Flag
Warning.

* AFFECTED AREA...Portions of the Sierra Nevada and adjacent
Foothills.

* TIMING...From midnight tonight to 10 AM PDT Friday.

* WINDS...Northeast to east winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts 25 to 45
mph.

* RELATIVE HUMIDITY...Daytime humidity 10 to 25% with single digits
possible and very poor overnight recoveries.

* IMPACTS...Any fires that develop will spread rapidly. Outdoor
burning is not recommended.

alerts.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 14 at 1:16PM PDT until October 16 at 11:00AM PDT by NWS Las Vegas NV
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 50 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Southern Owens Valley, Northwest Plateau, Hualapai
Mountains, Northwest Deserts, Death Valley National Park, Western
Clark and Southern Nye County, Sheep Range, and Spring
Mountains-Red Rock Canyon.

* WHEN...From 8 AM PDT / MST Thursday to 11 AM PDT / MST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
